cohort: 1,516 women without gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) by Danish criteria
finding: The World Health Organization (WHO) 2013 FVPG threshold for GDM is unsuitable for Denmark, as it identifies a large number of women as having GDM who are at low risk of pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: There was no evidence of excess cesarean delivery in women with FVPG <5.6 mmol/L.
